freeze_stage: After training-only development and regression checks; before first development/test/pending masking run
seed_use: Inherited split provenance; masking is deterministic and sample review is purposive, not randomized
remove: Formal disposition blocks and opening disposition synopses
Explicit current appellate results, including repeated statements
Explicit appellate endorsement/rejection of granting or denying operative relief
Bare agreement/disagreement immediately following explicit party argument about the reviewed ruling
preserve: Facts and procedural history without appellate endorsement
Cited outcomes, party requests, hypotheticals and indirect legal reasoning
The same pre-existing FULL content in every condition before additional masking
method: Sentence removals with exact offsets into frozen FULL; normalize whitespace only; no case-specific overrides
symmetry: Identical patterns and contextual tests for every case, without receiving target labels
evaluation_policy: Apply unchanged after freeze. Do not manually revise evaluation text using outcomes or annotation evidence. Any future rule change needs a new version and affected experiments rerun.
ambiguity_policy: Retain uncertain cues and flag for review; flags do not imply verified leakage
limitations: Rule-based legal sentence segmentation cannot guarantee exhaustive semantic accuracy
Whole-sentence removal may also remove reasoning within a direct-outcome sentence
Remaining legal reasoning can still predict outcome; MASKED is not a prospective prediction dataset
Existing source OCR and FULL limitations persist
pre_evaluation_metadata_correction: Corrected sample note to computed 64 retained words before evaluation processing; masking code unchanged.
